datasets.name: SECOM semiconductor manufacturing
datasets.version: publisher archive retrieved on date; no upstream semantic version declared
datasets.changes: None to archive; profiling is a separate derived QA artifact
datasets.description: 1,567 process examples. Numeric file has 590 sensor/process columns; the page says 591 features, creating a metadata discrepancy. Labels/timestamps are in the separate aligned file. Signal names, engineering units and machine identities are anonymized.
datasets.limitations: Keep numeric row i aligned with label row i; do not fabricate sensor meanings. Preserve NaN. Do not infer a common timezone. Use chronological or production-aware splits only after reviewing the source timestamps.
datasets.row_grain: see per-file schema; cycle/channel rows must not be summed as independent events
datasets.timezone: not asserted unless original source declares it
datasets.refresh: historical archive, not a live feed

datasets.name: Individual household electric power consumption
datasets.version: publisher archive retrieved on date; no upstream semantic version declared
datasets.changes: None to archive; profiling is a separate derived QA artifact
datasets.description: 2,075,259 minute records from one household in Sceaux, France, 2006–2010. This is measured energy data, not a factory dataset. Source units: active/reactive power kW, voltage V, intensity A, sub-metering Wh.
datasets.limitations: Use as an energy/time-series companion. Preserve ? and empty missing measurements; never turn them into zeros. Do not relabel the residence as an industrial asset.

datasets.name: Hydraulic system condition monitoring
datasets.authors: Nikolai Helwig, Eliseo Pignanelli and Andreas Schuetze (2015), ZeMA
datasets.version: publisher archive retrieved on date; no upstream semantic version declared
datasets.changes: None to archive; profiling is a separate derived QA artifact
datasets.description: 2,205 controlled 60-second cycles, 17 sensor/derived channels. PS1–PS6 pressure bar and EPS1 motor power W at 100 Hz; FS1–FS2 flow l/min at 10 Hz; TS1–TS4 temperature °C and VS1 vibration mm/s at 1 Hz. CE cooling efficiency and CP cooling power are explicitly virtual channels; SE is an efficiency factor.
datasets.limitations: Rows are cycles, columns are relative samples. No absolute wall-clock timestamps are supplied. Preserve cycle/column positions; no invented UTC time or real-time replay presented as observed. Four fault-severity labels and the stability flag reside in profile.txt. This is a laboratory rig, not unrestricted field machinery telemetry.
datasets.row_grain: see per-file schema; cycle/channel rows must not be summed as independent events
datasets.timezone: not asserted unless original source declares it
datasets.refresh: historical archive, not a live feed

datasets.name: Metro Interstate Traffic Volume
datasets.version: publisher archive retrieved on date; no upstream semantic version declared
datasets.changes: None to archive; profiling is a separate derived QA artifact
datasets.description: 48,204 hourly records at MN DoT ATR station 301, I-94 westbound, 2012–2018. Units include Kelvin, rain/snow mm, cloud %, and traffic volume. Source says local CST; naive values are retained.
datasets.limitations: Multiple weather observations can share an hour. Do not sum duplicate timestamps as independent traffic counts without a declared rule. The string None in holiday means no holiday, not a missing observation. This is a transport-demand proxy, not carrier shipment events.

datasets.name: Steel industry energy consumption

datasets.version: publisher archive retrieved on date; no upstream semantic version declared

datasets.limitations: The source labels CO2(tCO2) while describing ppm; retain both and mark the unit unresolved. Location does not establish timestamp timezone. No alarm threshold, anomaly ground truth or equipment identity was invented.

datasets.name: Logistics Performance Index
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 plus World Bank dataset additional terms; displayed on indicator page
datasets.description: Perception-based country/economy logistics index, scale 1–5. It is an aggregate of survey responses, not actual shipment timings.
datasets.limitations: API returns countries and regional/income aggregates together; null slots are not observations. Do not sum overlapping aggregates with their member countries. Source metadata retained separately; no microdata or causal conclusion.

datasets.name: Container port traffic
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 plus World Bank dataset additional terms; displayed on indicator page
datasets.description: Country/economy annual container traffic in TEU, sourced through World Bank WDI from UNCTAD. Empty containers and transshipment lifts are included; this is an aggregate, not a container-event trace.
datasets.limitations: API returns countries and regional/income aggregates together; null slots are not observations. Do not sum overlapping aggregates with their member countries. Source metadata retained separately; no microdata or causal conclusion.
